'''The Trouble With Tribbles''' base set is the 22nd expansion of [[Star Trek CCG 1st Edition]]. It is published by [[Decipher]] on 9 August 2000. The set consists of 141 cards in the base set and 96 cards in the starter decks. This base set was the first expansion to include card numbers.

The set is available in 11-card booster packs with 30 booster packs per box. The booster packs come in six different wrapper designs with either Kirk, Spock, McCoy, Uhura, Worf or Odo on the front. Also available are boxes of pre-constructed starter decks. There are 12 starter decks per box (6 Federation and 6 Klingon). The starter decks include a 44 page Rules and Card List booklet.

Each type of "The Trouble With Tribbles" starter deck, Federation & Klingon. has one exclusive card being counted as a base set card: Lt. Sisko (Federation) and Captain Koloth (Klingon). Both decks have one card in common, Menthar Booby Trap. There are 51 cards in the Federation deck and 46 in the Klingon deck: 96 unique (reprinted from earlier editions) cards. In addition, 27 of the cards in the starter decks have some tribble images added to their image. All these cards have the same copyright line as The Trouble With Tribbles base set cards.

'''The Trouble With Tribbles''' expansion base set's last 22 cards are the special "game within the game" cards.

This set is noted for the following:
*Included the first Ultra Rare card since the [[Alternate Universe (expansion)|Alternate Universe]] expansion set: '''Dr. McCoy'''
*The Dr. McCoy card was chosen to be Ultra Rare as a way of paying homage to DeForest Kelley who passed away the previous year
*The names of the two agents from the Department of Temporal Investigations, Dulmer and Lucsly, are anagrams of the two X-Files agents, Mulder and Scully
*Introduced the TOS property logo
*Introduced the first appearance of the silver TOS staffing icon
*Each Starter deck contained re-printed cards from previous expansions (with the 2000 copyright line), for which several of these cards were duplicated and included 'added' tribbles to them resulting on them being in the set twice
*The first appearance of Tribbles and Trouble cards

==='''Starter Decks'''===

Two Starter Decks were made for this set, a Federation Starter deck and a Klingon Starter deck. Cards in these two Starter decks were from previous expansions with several cards in these Starter decks modified with the addition of ‘’’tribbles’’ in the card photo.

The first table lists the cards found in these Starter decks. The rarity designation for these cards is ‘’’Starter’’’, which differs from the rarity designation in their original expansion sets.

The card links in the table are for the 27 cards that were modified to include ‘’’tribbles’’ in the card photo. The remaining starter cards do not have a card link and only its card title is listed. They re identical to the cards in the original expansion set except for the copyright date. The table also refers to the expansion set the cards are originally from.
